title: Help for Home Owners to Assess if Their Homes Meet Requirement for Residual Current Circuit Breaker
what_it_is: Help for Home Owners to Assess if Their Homes Meet Requirement for Residual Current Circuit Breaker

sections.label: HDB RCCB notification to residents
sections.summary: HDB has notified residents of pre-July 1985 1-room and 2-room flats of the requirement and will progressively notify those in 3-room and larger flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Housing and Development Board (HDB) has notified all residents living in 1-room and 2-room flats built before July 1985 of this requirement and will be progressively notifying residents living in 3-room and larger flats built before July 1985.

sections.label: Inspections and RCCB installations
sections.summary: For pre-July 1985 1-room and 2-room flats, HDB conducted door-to-door inspections and completed RCCB installations for inspected units without an RCCB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For those living in 1-room and 2-room flats built before July 1985, HDB has conducted door-to-door inspections and also completed RCCB installations for inspected units without an RCCB.

sections.label: RCCB Installation Assistance Programme subsidies
sections.summary: Under the programme, Government fully subsidises RCCB installation for pre-July 1985 1-room and 2-room flats and subsidises up to 95% for 3-room or larger flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Under HDB’s RCCB Installation Assistance Programme, the Government will fully subsidise the cost of RCCB installations for those living in 1-room and 2-room HDB flats built before July 1985.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For those living in 3-room or larger flats that were built before July 1985, the Government will subsidise up to 95% of the cost of RCCB installations.

sections.label: Pre-1985 flats total 382,000
sections.summary: The exercise reaches residents of pre-1985-built homes, some possibly without RCCB, and there are 382,000 flats built before July 1985.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, this exercise, as Mr Saktiandi Supaat had said, reaches out to the residents of pre-1985-built homes and some of them may not have any RCCB.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: We have worked with HDB, and we understand that there are a total of 382,000 flats that were built before July 1985.

sections.label: 95 of 4,400 lacked RCCB
sections.summary: Out of the 4,400, only 95, or 2%, did not have RCCB installed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Out of the 4,400, only 95, or 2%, did not have RCCB installed.

sections.label: Government RCCB installation subsidies
sections.summary: The Government fully pays RCCB installation for 1-room and 2-room households and provides subsidies up to 95% for bigger HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Which is why, earlier on, I mentioned that the cost of the RCCB installation for households from 1-room and 2-room flats will be fully paid for by the Government.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Under the HDB RCCB Installation Assistance Programme, the Government is providing substantial subsidies up to 95% for households of bigger HDB flats.
